name: components-community-share-button
title: Share Button
description: A wide pale button showing a share glyph and the word Share; on hover the label slides away and three social icons pop up in its place, each lifting when pointed at.
use: A button should offer several share destinations without opening a menu or modal.
avoid: Touch has no hover, so the platform icons stay hidden until a tap, which also counts as the share.
a11y: The platform icons are clickable divs with no role or label that appear only on hover, so keyboard and screen-reader users cannot use them. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide, rounded rectangle of pale grey on a near-black stage, with a black share glyph and the word Share centred inside. Swapped, the same surface holds three black icons spaced in a row.
behaves: On hover the label slides up and fades out while the three icons spring up from below; leaving reverses it. Each icon also jumps a little higher when the pointer reaches it.
customise: The label comes in as children, and size, icon side and a per-platform callback are props; the three platforms and their icons are fixed in source.
weight: light: One button with a short slide and three icons; idle when not hovered.
